description: Book an appointment. Books a slot the way the portal calendar does: the account's required customer fields are enforced (422 missing_fields), the time must be in the future and free (409 slot_unavailable), the appointment is confirmed at once, synced to Google Calendar and GoHighLevel when connected, and appointment.booked fires. Attach conversation_id to book for a person you are chatting with; they get the confirmation DM unless send_confirmation is false. date and time are the customer's wall-clock time in timezone (the account timezone when omitted).

conversation_id.description: Book for the person in this conversation; sets the channel and enables the confirmation DM.

duration_minutes.description: Defaults to the service's duration, else 30.

send_confirmation.description: With conversation_id: DM the customer the confirmation.

service_type.description: A bookable service name from ai/config booking.bookable_services, or free text.

timezone.description: IANA name. Default: the account timezone.

name: book_appointment
